answer: The Dedicated device bound by in-person pickup code with one identity per channel makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Even a quiet ripple gets heard, because binding weighs evidence, not volume. From the oasis to the signal, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
